_comment: Regression harness for MonitorLocalizer.localize_frame(). Each row drives the per-frame payload through one labeled scenario. Schema: `expected` fields are all optional — the harness treats absent as 'don't care, but warn if a value comes through that the manifest didn't list' so adding a new field to the payload does not break older rows. Rows with `source == 'synthetic'` are SKIPPED unless `RUN_SYNTHETIC=1` is set. Customer / brand names are placeholders (brand_a/b/c); real brand tokens go in the `note` field only when they describe a known app-grid node (e.g. apps_netflix) — see AGENTS.md leak-gate rule.

rows.note: Switch HOME menu (174 of 200 frames in pi3 widened). Caption: home, no focus, frozen UI. Pin: stb_tv home is recognized, no overlay, playback N/A on a frozen menu.
Same screen with focus highlight on a tile; matcher should still answer 'home' (focus ring does not move the page). 2nd of >=2 for the home cluster.

Broadcast promo slate with channel bugelogo, distinct #1 (slot 108000 — 14kB frame, the smaller variant). Pin: held-promo node; Tier 2 still 'not_applicable' for playback because is_media is not wired into the standalone monitor (matches EXPERIMENT-01 §0 'playback is the right answer' caveat — Tier 2 will answer 'unknown' here too, harness documents that).

Broadcast promo slate with channel bugelogo, distinct #2 (slot 108195 — same 14kB variant as distinct #1, this is the same screen at a different time). The 'distinct' count in EXPERIMENT-01 §0 row 1 ('3 distinct') is by visual content; the 14kB frames are all the same slate. The 35kB frames in this dir are a different slate.

Broadcast promo slate with channel bugelogo, distinct #3. Synthetic — only 2 distinct promo slates available in the local pull (pi1 capture4); 3rd is a placeholder until pi1 capture4 has a 3rd unique frame.
Nintendo Switch game title screen (pi3 capture2 first frame). Pin: a Switch userinterface with no company set (NULL); userinterface_company is absent from the payload — NOT brand_a or brand_b.
Game title screen, 2nd of >=2 for the cluster. Confirms the match is stable across two captures. Slot 000195 — same screen as slot 000000, ~40s later in the same 5-min window.

In-game cutscene, distinct #1. Low-pct minor motion (sub-floor), gate stays open (kind=='minor' & pct <= 1.0). Slot 108000 — the 14kB variant in pi3 capture2; visually different from the 35kB slot-0 frames.

In-game cutscene, distinct #2. Synthetic — only 1 cutscene frame is reliably identifiable in the local pull; the 4 distinct cutscenes from EXPERIMENT-01 §0 row 1 are all on pi3 widened, not in this pull.
In-game cutscene, distinct #3. Synthetic placeholder.
In-game cutscene, distinct #4. Synthetic placeholder.

Error dialog — raised panel over dimmed backdrop, distinct #1 (per EXPERIMENT-01 §0 row 1). Synthetic — no real frame for this row in the local pull. Tier-2 cascade: overlay='popup' (_dialog_plate), error='visible' (literal 'Error' or 'Failed' in OCR tokens).
Error dialog — raised panel over dimmed backdrop, distinct #2. Synthetic placeholder.

2048 web game. Synthetic — the 2048 frames in the pi1 dump were 'text_source_image*' files, UI screenshots ingested as text sources (EXPERIMENT-01 §0 caveat), not actual captures. Tier 2: 2048 is a static page between moves, no overlay, no error.
2048 web game during a swipe — localized box motion (one tile merging). Gate stays open (kind=='box'). Synthetic placeholder.

Android quick-settings shade (per EXPERIMENT-01 §7.1 item 1, this is the device on pi1 capture1). Synthetic — no real frame in the local pull. Tier 2: overlay='notification' (a banner-style shade hugs the top-right).
Black / screensaver frame. Gate open (state=blackscreen, not live/motion). Tier 2: loaded='no' (converged but black — the brightness gate fires; the harness must mock scv.screen_state accordingly).
Black / screensaver frame, 2nd. Same expected; confirms a stretch of blackness answers consistently.

Live TV, full-frame motion. Gate fires ('live'); Tier 2 cascade is skipped on a gate_skip; loaded/overlay/playback/error are ALL absent from the payload (matches test_localize_tier2.test_tier2_fields_absent_on_a_gate_skip).

Screensaver / no-signal forest aerial (aerial photograph, sunlit tree tops covering the bottom strip). Same frame as live_tv_full_motion, but motion is 'static' so the gate stays open and Tier 2 runs. Pin: overlay MUST be 'none', NOT 'keyboard' — the geometric keyboard test (wide plate near the bottom edge) used to fire on this because the brightness of the sunlit trees passed the absolute threshold; the top-edge-contrast gate added in fix/localize-keyboard-threshold rejects it (the plate has no real top edge, top_diff=2.2). The Clash of Clans number-pad modal still answers 'popup' (top_diff=71.7).
Live TV, 2nd of >=2. Slot 108000 — the largest frames in pi3 capture3 (207kB, well clear of any drawn UI). Same gate_skip behavior; cached `node` (if any) is served with confidence 0.

Transition tail (motion→static) — the gate force-matches on this tick. The harness cannot directly observe the force flag (it is internal), but it CAN observe that the matcher ran (Tier 2 is present, gate_skip is absent). Synthetic placeholder.
Transition start (static→motion) — gate fires ('motion'). Cached verdict is served. Synthetic placeholder.
Sustained live (full-frame, no node). 2nd tick in a sustained-live stretch. Gate still 'live'; same payload. Synthetic placeholder.

Tile-to-tile focus move on an app grid (box, very low pct). Gate open (kind=='box'); matcher must update to the newly-focused tile. Pin: a focus move IS visible to the matcher even though pct < 1% — see the localize_frame comment at backend_host/scripts/monitor_localize.py:466-472 ('a dHash gate would freeze the verdict on the previous tile').
Tier-2 `error == 'visible'` positive. A frame with the literal text 'Error' or 'Failed' in OCR tokens. The harness must mock scv.error to return 'visible'. Synthetic placeholder.
Tier-2 `error == 'none'` negative. A normal home frame, no error tokens in OCR. The harness must mock scv.error to return 'none'.
Tier-2 `overlay == 'popup'` positive. A known confirmation dialog (raised plate over dimmed page, _dialog_plate geometry). The harness must mock scv.overlay to return 'popup'.
Tier-2 `overlay == 'none'` negative. Plain home frame, no plate / tooltip / keyboard / notification geometry.

Tier-2 `playback == 'playing'` positive on a band-motion frame. Pin: the gate fires first, so Tier 2 is NOT in the payload — the harness asserts the gate_skip behavior. (The 'playback' field only appears when the gate is open and is_media is wired; today it is not — see test_localize_tier2:99-103.) Synthetic placeholder.
Tier-2 `playback == 'not_applicable'` negative — a static home menu, no media surface.

Tier-2 `loaded == 'no'` positive. A frame mid-render (consecutive high `changed_pct`; pct=5.0 here is well above LOADED_STABLE_PCT=0.8). Gate open (kind='minor' pct=5.0 > GATE_MINOR_PCT_FLOOR=1.0 would actually gate-skip — but we keep this at the boundary to assert loaded; harness uses 1.2% if the gate fires instead). Synthetic placeholder.
Tier-2 `loaded == 'yes'` negative. A settled home frame, fully drawn.

Company passthrough + brand-aware error arm. The userinterface has `company='brand_a'` and the frame contains the literal token `BRAND_A` (or `brand_a`) in OCR. Pin: payload carries `userinterface_company='brand_a'` AND scv.error is called with `brand_a` as an extra keyword AND returns 'visible'. The harness mocks the userinterface record cache to set company='brand_a', and mocks scv.error to simulate the brand-aware branch.

Company passthrough on a gate_skip. Cached `userinterface_company` is still carried in the payload (it's metadata, not a measurement). Pin: matches test_userinterface_company_passthrough.test_gate_skip_carries_cached_company.

Control: when `userinterface_company` is set on a UI but the row's `expected` does NOT list it, the harness must NOT silently pass — the field is unexpected and should trigger a warning (the 'warn if a value comes through that the manifest didn't list' rule). We do not list it here to prove the warning path is live. (Set company='brand_b' on this userinterface; the field WILL come through; the harness warns.)
